steps.description: Search for Cliff Asness's academic papers, AQR white papers, blog articles, and books. Focus on factor investing, multi-factor models, momentum, value, quality, defensive equity. Must include latest (2024-2026) publications.
Search for Cliff Asness interviews, podcast appearances, conference talks, AQR Capital presentations. Must include latest (2024-2026) interviews.
Analyze Asness's speaking/writing style, reasoning patterns, go-to phrases, how he explains complex quant concepts.
Search for how others view Asness (critiques, interviews about him, academic citations, media profiles).
Research Asness's key investment decisions: AQR founding, factor timing debates, 2008 crisis, LTCM experience, quant crash of 2007.
Build a comprehensive timeline of Asness's life, career, AQR milestones, key publications.
Based on all references, write SKILL.md following Anthropic skill specification format. Include effect examples, expression DNA, mental models, decision heuristics, and investment cases.
Write _meta.json with metadata, tags, triggers, sources.

rules: Long documents must summarize core points + attach links
References 01-writings and 02-conversations are foundational — search thoroughly for latest materials
Wait for user confirmation after each step
